fixes.text: VERDICT: The Sixth National Government is a coalition led by Christopher Luxon, formed in November 2023. WHY: It unites the National Party with ACT New Zealand and New Zealand First, headed by David Seymour and Winston Peters respectively. TRAPS: Do not confuse it with the Fifth National Government (2017-2020) or assume it is a single-party rule; the coalition structure is the defining feature.
